Andrographis Paniculata Extract Supplier: Discover Kalmegh Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Kalmegh powder is the dried, milled aerial part of Andrographis paniculata, a very bitter herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations. Buyers searching for an andrographis paniculata extract supplier often need the plain herb powder as a raw material, and that is what we supply. Tradenest Naturals processes kalmegh under careful controls for supplement and herbal brands abroad. Our process is simple. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean, dehydrate and mill the herb, then sieve it to size. Our kalmegh powder wholesale stock is checked lot by lot for colour, texture and moisture. You can expect consistent lots across repeat orders.

Why Choose Our Kalmegh Herb Powder Bulk Buy?

Supplement brands need clear specifications and dependable supply. Our processing follows food hygiene practices under our FSSAI registration. When you work with us as your kalmegh powder supplier and exporter in India, you get supply that can grow with your orders. We also offer OEM and private label packing for your brand.
  • Pure & Natural: Plain kalmegh herb with no added fillers or colours.
  • Fine, Even Grind: Milled to 80-100 mesh for capsule filling and blending.
  • Strict Quality Control: A specification sheet comes with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.
  • Global Export Readiness: As an IEC registered exporter, we give export documentation support for customs clearance.

Technical Specifications and Processing

Care starts with the raw herb and continues through milling and packing. Our kalmegh powder exporter packing uses moisture barrier bags. Moisture is kept at or below 8% to prevent caking in storage. Our standard particle size is 80-100 mesh. This fine texture suits capsule filling, tablet making and herbal tea blending. If you need a different mesh size, our team can discuss custom milling with you.

Applications Across Diverse Industries

Our bulk kalmegh powder supplier service covers several sectors. Traditional herbal brands use this bitter herb in many classic blends. Some cosmetic formulators also add it to herbal skin care products. Here are the main industries we serve:
  • Nutraceuticals: Used in capsules and herbal supplement blends.
  • Ayurveda & Herbal Medicine: A traditional ingredient in classic Ayurvedic formulations.
  • Animal Feed: Used in some herbal feed premixes.
  • Cosmetics: Added to herbal face packs and skin creams.

Packaging Options and Shelf-Life Stability

Good packing protects botanical powders from moisture and light. We use food-grade multi-wall bags, HDPE containers and export drums. Pack sizes range from small retail pouches to bulk industrial sacks. Each pack is sealed to keep the powder dry and protect its natural aroma. Under recommended storage conditions, the shelf life is 24 months. We ship worldwide from India and help arrange freight to your port.
